description: Senior-level Min_Salary_USD is $1,050, which is implausibly low given Mid-level minimum is $72,000 and Senior Max_Salary_USD is $158,000. The correct value is $105,000 — two trailing zeros were dropped during entry.
business_context: HR salary band management. An incorrect minimum salary for Senior level would cause automated offer letters and equity eligibility calculations to apply wrong compensation thresholds.
